rationale: Ground truth for this trivial seed-removal PR is essentially 'LGTM' with no substantive concerns, so neither candidate missed real issues (recall is near-vacuous for both). X returns a bare zero-finding report with no visible investigation or evidence, which is safe but adds no value. Y traces the actual seed-propagation mechanism through source (serving_speech.py, gpu_model_runner.py), confirms the fix is correct, reaches the same approve verdict as the human reviewer, and adds a concrete non-blocking file/line suggestion (guard comment against regression) — more grounded effort and far more actionable, at some cost to verifiability of unshown-file specifics.
